functions.name: CAC_ScaledValueConfig_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataAttribute* CAC_ScaledValueConfig_create(const char* name, ModelNode* parent);
functions.description: Creates a ScaledValueConfig constructed data attribute under the given parent. Typically used to hold scaling information for measured values.
requirements: name must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid ModelNode.

functions.name: CAC_Unit_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataAttribute* CAC_Unit_create(const char* name, ModelNode* parent, bool hasMagnitude);
functions.description: Creates a Unit constructed data attribute under the parent. Optionally includes magnitude information.
requirements: name must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid ModelNode.
hasMagnitude indicates whether a magnitude sub-attribute is included.

functions.name: CDA_OperBoolean
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataAttribute* CDA_OperBoolean(ModelNode* parent, bool isTImeActivated);
functions.description: Creates a Boolean Oper (operation) data attribute under the given parent. The isTImeActivated flag indicates a time-activated variant (per control models).
requirements: parent must be a valid ModelNode.
isTImeActivated selects the time-activated form if true.

functions.name: CDC_SPS_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_SPS_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Single Point Status (SPS) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid LogicalNode or DataObject (as per library CDC parenting rules; default note says LogicalNode and DataObject are allowed for CDCs unless specified otherwise).
options is a bitmask of CDC_OPTION_* flags controlling optional elements; include “standard” options if extension namespaces/descriptions are desired.

functions.name: CDC_DPS_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_DPS_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Double Point Status (DPS) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a bitmask of CDC_OPTION_* flags (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_INS_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_INS_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates an Integer Status (INS) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_ENS_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ENS_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates an Enumerated Status (ENS) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_BCR_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_BCR_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Binary Counter Reading (BCR) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_VSS_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_VSS_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a ValWithTrans Status (VSS) CDC data object under the given parent. Purpose inferred from name; detailed composition not documented here.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a valid LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_SEC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_SEC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Security violation (SEC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options include address and additional info fields.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_ADDR (client address), CDC_OPTION_ADDINFO (additional info), and standard options for descriptions/namespaces.

functions.name: CDC_MV_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_MV_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, bool isIntegerNotFloat);
functions.description: Creates a Measured Value (MV) CDC data object under the given parent. The value type can be integer or float; options control inclusion of InstMag, Range, substitution, and standard optional elements.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_INST_MAG, CDC_OPTION_RANGE, CDC_OPTION_PICS_SUBST, and standard options (descriptions/namespaces).
Set isIntegerNotFloat=true to use integer AnalogueValue, false to use floating point.

functions.name: CDC_CMV_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_CMV_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Complex Measured Value (CMV) CDC data object under the given parent. Options control inclusion of instantaneous magnitude and range.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_INST_MAG and CDC_OPTION_RANGE, plus standard options.

functions.name: CDC_SAV_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_SAV_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, bool isIntegerNotFloat);
functions.description: Creates a Sampled Analog Value (SAV) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include unit, AC_SCAV, min, max, and standard optional elements; the analogue value representation may be integer or float.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_UNIT, CDC_OPTION_AC_SCAV, CDC_OPTION_MIN, CDC_OPTION_MAX, and standard options (descriptions/namespaces).
Set isIntegerNotFloat=true to use integer AnalogueValue, false for float.

functions.name: CDC_LPL_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_LPL_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Logical node name plate (LPL) CDC data object. Allowed parent type is LogicalNode. Options include mandatory/extended LN0/DLD fields and standard description/namespace elements.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode (allowed parent type is LogicalNode).

options may include: CDC_OPTION_AC_LN0_M (configRev), CDC_OPTION_AC_LN0_EX (ldNs), CDC_OPTION_AC_DLD_M (lnNs), CDC_OPTION_DESC (d), CDC_OPTION_DESC_UNICODE (du), CDC_OPTION_AC_DLNDA (cdcNs, cdcName), CDC_OPTION_AC_DLN (dataNs).

functions.name: CDC_DPL_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_DPL_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Device name plate (DPL) CDC data object. Allowed parent type is LogicalNode. Options include hardware/software revisions, serial number, model, location, and extension/data namespaces.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode (allowed parent type is LogicalNode).

options may include: CDC_OPTION_DPL_HWREV, CDC_OPTION_DPL_SWREV, CDC_OPTION_DPL_SERNUM, CDC_OPTION_DPL_MODEL, CDC_OPTION_DPL_LOCATION, CDC_OPTION_AC_DLNDA (cdcNs, cdcName), CDC_OPTION_AC_DLN (dataNs).

functions.name: CDC_HST_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_HST_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint16_t maxPts);
functions.description: Creates a History (HST) CDC data object under the given parent with optional parts and a maximum number of points.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).
maxPts specifies the maximum number of points; must fit in uint16_t (exact range constraints not documented).

functions.name: CDC_ACD_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ACD_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Directional protection activation information (ACD) CDC data object under the given parent. Options control which phase attributes are included.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_PHASE_A, CDC_OPTION_PHASE_B, CDC_OPTION_PHASE_C, CDC_OPTION_PHASE_NEUT, CDC_OPTION_PHASES_ABC, CDC_OPTION_PHASES_ALL, and standard options.

functions.name: CDC_ACT_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ACT_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Protection activation information (ACT) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_SPG_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_SPG_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Single Point Setting (SPG) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_VSG_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_VSG_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a Visible String Setting (VSG) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_ENG_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ENG_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates an Enumerated status setting (ENG) CDC data object under the given parent.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (standard optional elements available).

functions.name: CDC_ING_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ING_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates an Integer status setting (ING) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include unit, min, max, and step size.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_UNIT, CDC_OPTION_MIN, CDC_OPTION_MAX, CDC_OPTION_STEP_SIZE, and standard options.

functions.name: CDC_ASG_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ASG_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, bool isIntegerNotFloat);
functions.description: Creates an Analogue Setting (ASG) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include unit, min, max, step size; value representation may be integer or float.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_UNIT, CDC_OPTION_MIN, CDC_OPTION_MAX, CDC_OPTION_STEP_SIZE, and standard options.
Set isIntegerNotFloat=true for integer representation, false for floating point.

functions.name: CDC_WYE_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_WYE_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a WYE CDC data object (phase-to-ground/neutral measured values of a three-phase system) under the given parent. Options may include an angle reference.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_ANGLE_REF.

functions.name: CDC_DEL_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_DEL_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options);
functions.description: Creates a DEL CDC data object (phase-to-phase related measured values of a three-phase system) under the given parent. Options may include an angle reference.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: CDC_OPTION_ANGLE_REF.

functions.name: CDC_SPC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_SPC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions);
functions.description: Creates a Controllable Single Point (SPC) CDC data object under the given parent. controlOptions selects the default control model and related control options.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options is a CDC_OPTION_* bitmask (may include substitution, description/namespace, and time-activated options where applicable).

controlOptions is a bitmask defining control model and options; use CDC_CTL_MODEL_* and CDC_CTL_OPTION_* flags (e.g., CDC_CTL_MODEL_DIRECT_NORMAL, CDC_CTL_MODEL_SBO_NORMAL, CDC_CTL_MODEL_HAS_CANCEL, CDC_CTL_OPTION_ORIGIN, etc.).

functions.name: CDC_DPC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_DPC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions);
functions.description: Creates a Controllable Double Point (DPC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options may include time-activated control, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option (per comment; named in header comments as CDC_OPTION_IS_TIME_ACTICATED), CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard description/namespace options.
controlOptions is a bitmask using CDC_CTL_MODEL_* and CDC_CTL_OPTION_* flags.

functions.name: CDC_INC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_INC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions);
functions.description: Creates a Controllable Integer Status (INC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include time-activated control, min/max, step size, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option (as named in comments), CDC_OPTION_MIN, CDC_OPTION_MAX, CDC_OPTION_STEP_SIZE, CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard options.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).

functions.name: CDC_ENC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ENC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions);
functions.description: Creates a Controllable Enumerated Status (ENC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include time-activated control, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option (as named in comments), CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard options.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).

functions.name: CDC_BSC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_BSC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, bool hasTransientIndicator);
functions.description: Creates a Binary controlled Step position (BSC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options include time-activated control, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options. The step position may include a transient indicator.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option, CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard options.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).
hasTransientIndicator indicates whether the step position includes a transient indicator.

functions.name: CDC_ISC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ISC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, bool hasTransientIndicator);
functions.description: Creates an Integer controlled Step position (ISC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options include time-activated control, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options. The step position may include a transient indicator.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option, CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard options.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).
hasTransientIndicator indicates whether the step position includes a transient indicator.

functions.name: CDC_APC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_APC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, bool isIntegerNotFloat);
functions.description: Creates a Controllable Analogue Process Value (APC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include time-activated control, min/max, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options. The process value may be integer or float.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option, CDC_OPTION_MIN, CDC_OPTION_MAX, CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard options.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).
isIntegerNotFloat selects integer (true) vs floating (false) value representation.

functions.name: CDC_BAC_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_BAC_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, bool isIntegerNotFloat);
functions.description: Creates a Binary controlled Analogue process value (BAC) CDC data object under the given parent. Options can include time-activated control, min/max, step size, substitution blocking enable, and standard options. controlOptions selects control model and options. The process value may be integer or float.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include: time-activated option, CDC_OPTION_MIN, CDC_OPTION_MAX, CDC_OPTION_STEP_SIZE, CDC_OPTION_BLK_ENA, and standard options.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).
isIntegerNotFloat selects integer (true) vs floating (false) value representation.

functions.name: CDC_SPV_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_SPV_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, uint32_t wpOptions, bool hasChaManRs);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61400-specific SPV CDC data object under the given parent. options/controlOptions/wpOptions are bitmasks; options may include IEC 61400 extensions (e.g., min/max measured value, totals, standard deviation, rates, access levels, counting options).
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.

options may include IEC 61400 flags: CDC_OPTION_61400_MIN_MX_VAL, CDC_OPTION_61400_MAX_MX_VAL, CDC_OPTION_61400_TOT_AV_VAL, CDC_OPTION_61400_SDV_VAL, CDC_OPTION_61400_INC_RATE, CDC_OPTION_61400_DEC_RATE, CDC_OPTION_61400_SP_ACS, CDC_OPTION_61400_CHA_PER_RS, CDC_OPTION_61400_CM_ACS, CDC_OPTION_61400_TM_TOT, CDC_OPTION_61400_COUNTING_* (and CDC_OPTION_61400_COUNTING_ALL).
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask (model and option flags).
wpOptions is a bitmask (exact flags are not detailed here; library-defined).
hasChaManRs indicates presence of a manual change reset attribute.

functions.name: CDC_STV_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_STV_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, uint32_t wpOptions, bool hasOldStatus);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61400-specific STV CDC data object under the given parent. options/controlOptions/wpOptions are bitmasks; may include IEC 61400 extensions. Optionally includes an old status field.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include IEC 61400 flags listed in this header (CDC_OPTION_61400_*).
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask.
wpOptions is a bitmask (library-defined flags).
hasOldStatus toggles inclusion of old status.

functions.name: CDC_CMD_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_CMD_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, uint32_t wpOptions, bool hasOldStatus, bool hasCmTm, bool hasCmCt);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61400-specific CMD CDC data object under the given parent. options/controlOptions/wpOptions are bitmasks; may include IEC 61400 extensions. Optional inclusions: old status, command time, and command count.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include IEC 61400 CDC_OPTION_61400_* flags.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask.
wpOptions is a bitmask (library-defined).
hasOldStatus toggles inclusion of old status.
hasCmTm toggles inclusion of command time.
hasCmCt toggles inclusion of command count.

functions.name: CDC_ALM_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_ALM_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, uint32_t wpOptions, bool hasOldStatus);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61400-specific ALM (alarm) CDC data object under the given parent. options/controlOptions/wpOptions are bitmasks; may include IEC 61400 extensions. Optionally includes old status.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include IEC 61400 CDC_OPTION_61400_* flags.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask.
wpOptions is a bitmask (library-defined).
hasOldStatus toggles inclusion of old status.

functions.name: CDC_CTE_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_CTE_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, uint32_t wpOptions, bool hasHisRs);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61400-specific CTE CDC data object under the given parent. options/controlOptions/wpOptions are bitmasks; may include IEC 61400 extensions. Optionally includes a historical reset attribute.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include IEC 61400 CDC_OPTION_61400_* flags.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask.
wpOptions is a bitmask (library-defined).
hasHisRs toggles inclusion of a historical reset field.

functions.name: CDC_TMS_create
functions.signature: LIB61850_API DataObject* CDC_TMS_create(const char* dataObjectName, ModelNode* parent, uint32_t options, uint32_t controlOptions, uint32_t wpOptions, bool hasHisRs);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61400-specific TMS CDC data object under the given parent. options/controlOptions/wpOptions are bitmasks; may include IEC 61400 extensions. Optionally includes a historical reset attribute.
requirements: dataObjectName must be a non-null C string.
parent must be a LogicalNode or DataObject.
options may include IEC 61400 CDC_OPTION_61400_* flags.
controlOptions is a CDC_CTL_* bitmask.
wpOptions is a bitmask (library-defined).
hasHisRs toggles inclusion of a historical reset field.

functions.name: IedModel_create
functions.description: Create a new IEC 61850 IedModel root node with the given name. Use for building a dynamic model programmatically.
requirements: name must be a valid null-terminated string.
The returned IedModel* must later be destroyed with IedModel_destroy when no longer needed.
Only intended for dynamic model creation (not for static, generator-produced models).

functions.name: IedModel_setIedNameForDynamicModel
functions.description: Set the configured IED name for a dynamically created model, overriding the default (e.g., "TEMPLATE"). Must be used for dynamic models instead of IedModel_setIedName.
requirements: self must be a valid, initialized IedModel* created for a dynamic model.
Must be called before IedServer_create.
name must be a valid null-terminated string.

functions.name: IedModel_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a dynamically created IedModel and free all associated memory.
requirements: model must be a model created dynamically (not a static model from static_model.c).
model must not be used after destruction.
Do not call on models managed elsewhere or compiled statically.

functions.name: LogicalDevice_create
functions.signature: LogicalDevice* LogicalDevice_create(const char* name, IedModel* parent);
functions.description: Create a new LogicalDevice and attach it to the given IedModel.
requirements: parent must be a valid IedModel* created by IedModel_create.
name must be a valid null-terminated string.
Caller owns the returned pointer within the model; it will be freed by IedModel_destroy.

functions.name: LogicalDevice_createEx
functions.signature: LogicalDevice* LogicalDevice_createEx(const char* inst, IedModel* parent, const char* ldName);
functions.description: Create a new LogicalDevice and attach it to the IedModel, optionally using functional naming with ldName.
requirements: parent must be a valid IedModel*.
inst must be a valid null-terminated string representing the LD instance.
If ldName is not NULL, its length must be <= 64 characters and functional naming will be used for this LD.
Returned LogicalDevice is owned by the model; freed with IedModel_destroy.

functions.name: LogicalNode_create
functions.signature: LogicalNode* LogicalNode_create(const char* name, LogicalDevice* parent);
functions.description: Create a new LogicalNode and add it to the specified LogicalDevice.
requirements: parent must be a valid LogicalDevice*.
name must be a valid null-terminated string.
Returned LogicalNode is owned by the model; freed with IedModel_destroy.

functions.name: DataObject_create
functions.signature: DataObject* DataObject_create(const char* name, ModelNode* parent, int arrayElements);
functions.description: Create a new DataObject (or an array DataObject) and add it to a parent ModelNode of type DataObject or LogicalNode. For arrays, element child DataObjects are created automatically.
requirements: parent must be a valid ModelNode of type DataObject or LogicalNode.
name must be a valid null-terminated string (e.g., "Mod", "Health").
arrayElements must be 0 for non-array, or a positive integer for arrays.
Returned DataObject is owned by the model; freed with IedModel_destroy.

functions.name: DataAttribute_create
functions.signature: DataAttribute* DataAttribute_create(const char* name, ModelNode* parent, DataAttributeType type, FunctionalConstraint fc, uint8_t triggerOptions, int arrayElements, uint32_t sAddr);
functions.description: Create a new DataAttribute and add it to a parent node (DataObject or DataAttribute). Supports constructed and array types, sets FC, trigger options, and optional short address.
requirements: parent must be a valid ModelNode of type DataObject or DataAttribute.
name must be a valid null-terminated string (e.g., "stVal").
type must be a valid DataAttributeType; use CONSTRUCTED when it has sub-attributes.
fc must be a valid FunctionalConstraint value for this attribute.
triggerOptions is a bit field specifying dupd, dchg, qchg triggers.
arrayElements must be 0 for non-array or a positive integer for arrays.
sAddr is optional short address; 0 if not used.
Returned DataAttribute is owned by the model; freed with IedModel_destroy.

functions.name: DataAttribute_getType
functions.description: Return the data type of the given DataAttribute.
requirements: self must be a valid DataAttribute*.

functions.name: DataAttribute_getFC
functions.description: Return the Functional Constraint (FC) of the given DataAttribute.
requirements: self must be a valid DataAttribute*.

functions.name: DataAttribute_getTrgOps

functions.name: IedConnection_readObject
functions.signature: MmsValue* IedConnection_readObject(IedConnection self, IedClientError* error, const char* dataAttributeReference, FunctionalConstraint fc);
functions.description: Reads a functional-constrained data attribute (FCDA) or functional-constrained data (FCD) from the server and returns the value as an MmsValue*. On success, returns a pointer to the received value; on failure, returns NULL and sets error. Use for generic reads when you know the IEC 61850 object reference and its functional constraint.
requirements: self must be a valid IedConnection; the connection should be established before calling (blocking read will fail if not connected).

error should point to a writable IedClientError location if the caller wants an error code; handle values such as IED_ERROR_OK on success or specific failure codes (e.g., IED_ERROR_NOT_CONNECTED, IED_ERROR_TIMEOUT, IED_ERROR_OBJECT_REFERENCE_INVALID, etc.).
dataAttributeReference must be a syntactically valid IEC 61850 reference for an FCDA/FCD that exists on the server (e.g., LD/LN.DO.DA or similar as per library conventions).
fc must match the target object’s functional constraint.
Caller must check the return value for NULL before use.

Ownership/lifetime of the returned MmsValue* is not specified in this header; consult the library documentation to determine whether the caller must free it (e.g., via MmsValue_delete) or whether it is managed by the library.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_create

requirements: Must be destroyed with IedServerConfig_destroy to avoid leaks.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_destroy
functions.description: Releases all resources associated with the given server configuration object.
requirements: self must be a valid configuration handle created by IedServerConfig_create.
Do not use self after calling this function.

functions.description: Sets the IEC 61850 standard edition (e.g., 1, 2, 2.1) to be used by the server instance.
requirements: self must be a valid configuration handle.
edition must be one of IEC_61850_EDITION_1, IEC_61850_EDITION_2, or IEC_61850_EDITION_2_1.

functions.description: Returns the configured IEC 61850 edition for the server configuration.
requirements: self must be a valid configuration handle.

requirements: self must be valid.
reportBufferSize should be non-negative and sized appropriately for expected report load (exact limits not specified).

functions.name: IedServerConfig_getReportBufferSize
functions.description: Gets the configured buffer size for each buffered report control block.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_setReportBufferSizeForURCBs
functions.description: Sets the per-RCB buffer size for unbuffered report control blocks (URCBs).
requirements: self must be valid.
reportBufferSize should be non-negative (exact limits not specified).

functions.name: IedServerConfig_getReportBufferSizeForURCBs

requirements: self must be valid.

requirements: self must be valid.

functions.description: Reports whether synchronized integrity report times are enabled.
requirements: self must be valid.

requirements: self must be valid.
basepath must be a valid, null-terminated path string; an internal copy may be stored (exact ownership not specified).

maxDataSetEntries should be non-negative.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_getMaxDatasSetEntries
functions.description: Returns the configured maximum number of entries allowed in dynamic data sets.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_enableLogService
functions.description: Enables or disables the IEC 61850 log service in MMS.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_enableEditSG
functions.description: Enables or disables the EditSG service allowing clients to change setting groups (enabled by default).
requirements: self must be valid.
When disabled, SGCB.ResvTms is not available online and setting of IedServerConfig_enableResvTmsForSGCB is ignored.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_enableResvTmsForSGCB
functions.description: Enables or disables visibility of SGCB.ResvTms when EditSG is enabled.
requirements: self must be valid.
Has no effect if EditSG is disabled.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_enableResvTmsForBRCB
functions.description: Enables or disables presence of BRCB.ResvTms (edition 2+).
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_isResvTmsForBRCBEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether BRCB.ResvTms is enabled (visible).
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_enableOwnerForRCB
functions.description: Enables or disables the owner attribute for report control blocks.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_isOwnerForRCBEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether the owner attribute is enabled for RCBs.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_useIntegratedGoosePublisher
functions.description: Enables or disables the integrated GOOSE publisher for configured GoCBs (enabled by default). Disable to integrate an external publisher.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_isLogServiceEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether the log service for MMS is enabled.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_setReportSetting
functions.signature: void IedServerConfig_setReportSetting(IedServerConfig self, uint8_t setting, bool isDyn);
functions.description: Sets a report setting’s writability. Controls if a report parameter is writable (Dyn) or read-only to emulate Services.ReportSettings options.
requirements: self must be valid.

setting must be one of IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_RPT_ID, IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_BUF_TIME, IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_DATSET, IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_TRG_OPS, IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_OPT_FIELDS, IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_INTG_PD.

functions.name: IedServerConfig_getReportSetting
functions.description: Returns whether a configurable report setting is writable (Dyn) or read-only.
requirements: self must be valid.
setting must be one of the defined IEC61850_REPORTSETTINGS_* constants.

functions.name: IedServer_create
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61850 server instance from the given IedModel without TLS.
requirements: dataModel must point to a valid IedModel describing the device data model.
Destroy with IedServer_destroy when no longer needed.

functions.name: IedServer_createWithTlsSupport
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61850 server instance from the given IedModel with optional TLS support.
requirements: dataModel must be valid.
tlsConfiguration may be NULL to disable TLS; otherwise must be a valid TLSConfiguration object compatible with the library build.

functions.name: IedServer_createWithConfig
functions.signature: IedServer IedServer_createWithConfig(IedModel* dataModel, TLSConfiguration tlsConfiguration, IedServerConfig serverConfiguration);
functions.description: Creates an IEC 61850 server instance with TLS (optional) and extended server configuration.
requirements: dataModel must be valid.
serverConfiguration must be a valid IedServerConfig (may be reused for multiple servers if supported; ownership not transferred per docs).
tlsConfiguration may be NULL to disable TLS.

functions.name: IedServer_destroy
functions.description: Destroys the server instance and releases all resources, including memory and TCP sockets.
requirements: self must be a valid server handle.
Must be stopped prior to destruction if running (implicit or explicit stop not stated).
Do not use self after this call.

functions.name: IedServer_addAccessPoint
functions.signature: bool IedServer_addAccessPoint(IedServer self, const char* ipAddr, int tcpPort, TLSConfiguration tlsConfiguration);
functions.description: Adds a local access point; the server will listen on the provided IP/port with optional TLS for this access point.
requirements: self must be valid.
ipAddr must be a valid local IP address string.
tcpPort must be a valid TCP port or -1 to use the standard MMS/secure MMS port.
tlsConfiguration may be NULL when TLS is not used for this access point.

functions.name: IedServer_setLocalIpAddress
functions.signature: void IedServer_setLocalIpAddress(IedServer self, const char* localIpAddress);
functions.description: Sets a single local IP address for the server to listen on (legacy/simple mode).
requirements: self must be valid.
localIpAddress must be a valid C string; the function creates an internal copy.

functions.name: IedServer_setServerIdentity
functions.signature: void IedServer_setServerIdentity(IedServer self, const char* vendor, const char* model, const char* revision);
functions.description: Configures the values returned by the MMS Identify service (vendor, model, revision). Requires CONFIG_IEC61850_SUPPORT_SERVER_IDENTITY.
requirements: self must be valid.
vendor, model, and revision must be valid null-terminated strings.
Feature CONFIG_IEC61850_SUPPORT_SERVER_IDENTITY must be enabled in the build.

functions.name: IedServer_setFilestoreBasepath
functions.signature: void IedServer_setFilestoreBasepath(IedServer self, const char* basepath);
functions.description: Sets the virtual filestore base path for MMS file services at runtime. Only available if CONFIG_SET_FILESTORE_BASEPATH_AT_RUNTIME is enabled.
requirements: self must be valid.
basepath must be a valid C string.
Build option CONFIG_SET_FILESTORE_BASEPATH_AT_RUNTIME must be enabled; otherwise this function may be unavailable/ineffective.

functions.name: IedServer_setLogStorage
functions.signature: void IedServer_setLogStorage(IedServer self, const char* logRef, LogStorage logStorage);
functions.description: Assigns a LogStorage instance to a log reference for the log service.
requirements: self must be valid.
logRef must be a valid log reference string.
logStorage must be a valid LogStorage instance.
CONFIG_IEC61850_LOG_SERVICE must be enabled.

functions.name: IedServer_start
functions.description: Starts the server’s threaded mode and begins handling client connections on the given port (-1 = default MMS or secure MMS port).
requirements: self must be valid and properly configured (model, optional TLS/APs).
tcpPort must be a valid port or -1 to use default.

functions.name: IedServer_stop
functions.description: Stops the server from handling client connections (threaded mode).
requirements: self must be valid.
Safe to call when not running (behavior not explicitly stated).

functions.name: IedServer_startThreadless
functions.description: Starts the server in non-threaded mode; caller must periodically drive processing via wait/process/periodic functions.
requirements: self must be valid.
tcpPort must be a valid port or -1 for default.
Caller must subsequently call IedServer_processIncomingData periodically and optionally IedServer_waitReady/IedServer_performPeriodicTasks.

functions.name: IedServer_waitReady
functions.signature: int IedServer_waitReady(IedServer self, unsigned int timeoutMs);
functions.description: Blocks until at least one connection is ready (data available) or timeout elapses in non-threaded mode. If return != 0, call IedServer_processIncomingData.
requirements: self must be valid.
timeoutMs is a timeout in milliseconds.

functions.name: IedServer_processIncomingData
functions.description: Processes incoming TCP/MMS data; call periodically in non-threaded mode for responsiveness.
requirements: self must be valid.
Should be called periodically or when data is indicated (e.g., after IedServer_waitReady).

functions.name: IedServer_performPeriodicTasks
functions.description: Performs periodic background tasks in non-threaded mode, improving timing accuracy for internal timeouts (e.g., reports).
requirements: self must be valid.
Should be called periodically in non-threaded mode.

functions.name: IedServer_stopThreadless
functions.description: Stops the server started in non-threaded mode.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServer_getDataModel
functions.description: Returns the IedModel instance associated with the server.
requirements: self must be valid.
Returned pointer is owned by the server; do not free.

functions.name: IedServer_isRunning
functions.description: Indicates if the server is currently listening for client connections.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServer_getNumberOfOpenConnections
functions.description: Returns the number of open and accepted MMS client connections.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServer_getMmsServer
functions.description: Returns the underlying MmsServer instance used by the IedServer. Direct interactions may interfere with IedServer behavior; use with care.
requirements: self must be valid.
Caller must avoid interfering with IedServer via the returned handle.

functions.name: IedServer_enableGoosePublishing
functions.description: Sets GoEna=true for all configured GOOSE control blocks, enabling GOOSE publishing.
requirements: self must be valid.
Has no effect when CONFIG_INCLUDE_GOOSE_SUPPORT is not set.

functions.name: IedServer_disableGoosePublishing
functions.description: Sets GoEna=false for all configured GOOSE control blocks, disabling GOOSE transmission.
requirements: self must be valid.
Has no effect when CONFIG_INCLUDE_GOOSE_SUPPORT is not set.

functions.name: IedServer_setGooseInterfaceId
functions.signature: void IedServer_setGooseInterfaceId(IedServer self, const char* interfaceId);
functions.description: Sets the Ethernet interface ID for GOOSE publishing. If NULL or not set, the default from stack_config.h is used.
requirements: self must be valid.
interfaceId is OS-specific; must match system naming.
Has no effect when CONFIG_INCLUDE_GOOSE_SUPPORT is not set.

functions.name: IedServer_setGooseInterfaceIdEx
functions.signature: void IedServer_setGooseInterfaceIdEx(IedServer self, LogicalNode* ln, const char* gcbName, const char* interfaceId);
functions.description: Sets the Ethernet interface ID for all GCBs (ln=NULL) or a specific GCB identified by LN instance and GCB name.
requirements: self must be valid.
ln may be NULL for applying to all GCBs; otherwise must reference the LN containing the GCB.
gcbName must be the GCB name (not object reference).
Has no effect when CONFIG_INCLUDE_GOOSE_SUPPORT is not set.

functions.name: IedServer_useGooseVlanTag
functions.signature: void IedServer_useGooseVlanTag(IedServer self, LogicalNode* ln, const char* gcbName, bool useVlanTag);
functions.description: Enables/disables VLAN tagging for all GCBs (ln=NULL) or a specific GCB.
requirements: self must be valid.
ln may be NULL to apply to all GCBs; otherwise must reference the LN containing the GCB.
gcbName is the GCB name.
Has no effect when CONFIG_INCLUDE_GOOSE_SUPPORT is not set.

functions.name: IedServer_setTimeQuality
functions.signature: void IedServer_setTimeQuality(IedServer self, bool leapSecondKnown, bool clockFailure, bool clockNotSynchronized, int subsecondPrecision);
functions.description: Sets the time quality flags and subsecond precision used for all timestamps internally generated by this server instance.
requirements: self must be valid.
subsecondPrecision is the number of significant bits of the fractionOfSecond field (exact valid range not specified).

functions.name: IedServer_setAuthenticator
functions.signature: void IedServer_setAuthenticator(IedServer self, AcseAuthenticator authenticator, void* authenticatorParameter);
functions.description: Sets the ACSE authenticator callback used to authenticate client connection attempts. If none is set, all clients are accepted.
requirements: self must be valid.
authenticator may be NULL to accept all clients; otherwise must follow AcseAuthenticator signature.
authenticatorParameter is passed through unmodified to the callback.

functions.name: ClientConnection_getPeerAddress
functions.description: Returns the peer (remote) address string for this client connection. Valid only while the connection exists; safe to use inside connection indication callback.
requirements: self must be a valid ClientConnection.
Returned string must not be used after the connection is closed; treat as read-only.

functions.name: ClientConnection_getLocalAddress
functions.description: Returns the local address string for this client connection. Valid only while the connection exists; safe to use inside connection indication callback.
requirements: self must be valid.
Returned string is ephemeral; treat as read-only and only while connection exists.

functions.name: ClientConnection_getSecurityToken
functions.description: Returns the opaque security token associated with the connection, if any, otherwise NULL. Tokens originate from the authenticator.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ClientConnection_abort
functions.description: Aborts/closes the client connection. After this call, the ClientConnection must not be used.
requirements: self must be valid.
After success, self is no longer usable.

functions.name: ClientConnection_claimOwnership
functions.description: Claims ownership of a ClientConnection to store and use it outside callbacks. Must later be released with ClientConnection_release to avoid leaks.
requirements: self must be valid.
Each claim must be paired with a corresponding ClientConnection_release.

functions.name: ClientConnection_release
functions.description: Releases ownership of a ClientConnection. Destroys the object when no owners remain. Reference must not be used after calling.
requirements: self must be a previously claimed ClientConnection.
Call exactly once per corresponding ClientConnection_claimOwnership for a specific instance.

functions.name: IedServer_setConnectionIndicationHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setConnectionIndicationHandler(IedServer self, IedConnectionIndicationHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when a client connects or a connection is closed/lost.
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match IedConnectionIndicationHandler signature.
parameter is user-defined and passed through.

functions.name: IedServer_ignoreClientRequests
functions.description: When enabled, the server will ignore all client requests at MMS layer (intended for testing).
requirements: self must be valid.
Intended for testing; will block client operations.

functions.name: IedServer_lockDataModel
functions.description: Locks the data model for updates, postponing client requests until unlocked. Do not call from inside library callbacks (the model is already locked there).
requirements: self must be valid.
Must not be called from within a library callback to avoid deadlocks.
Call IedServer_unlockDataModel after updates.

functions.name: IedServer_unlockDataModel
functions.description: Unlocks the data model and processes pending client requests. Do not call from inside library callbacks.
requirements: self must be valid.
Should only be called after a matching IedServer_lockDataModel.
Must not be called from within a library callback.

functions.name: IedServer_getAttributeValue
functions.description: Returns the MmsValue for a data attribute from the server cache. Do not modify directly; use IedServer_updateAttributeValue to ensure proper reporting/GOOSE behavior.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid handles.
May return NULL if the value does not exist.
Returned MmsValue is owned by server; do not free or mutate directly.

functions.name: IedServer_getBooleanAttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a boolean (MMS_BOOLEAN) data attribute value.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_BOOLEAN.

functions.name: IedServer_getInt32AttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a 32-bit integer (MMS_INTEGER) data attribute value.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_INTEGER.

functions.name: IedServer_getInt64AttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a 64-bit integer (MMS_INTEGER) data attribute value.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_INTEGER.

functions.name: IedServer_getUInt32AttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer (MMS_UNSIGNED) data attribute value.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_UNSIGNED.

functions.name: IedServer_getFloatAttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a 32-bit float (MMS_FLOAT) data attribute value.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_FLOAT.

functions.name: IedServer_getUTCTimeAttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a UTC time (MMS_UTC_TIME) data attribute value as milliseconds since epoch.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_UTC_TIME.

functions.name: IedServer_getBitStringAttributeValue
functions.description: Reads a bit-string (MMS_BIT_STRING) attribute and converts it to an integer via bit0^0 + bit1^1 + ... + bitn^n. Interpretation as integer is non-standard; use with care.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute is not MMS_BIT_STRING.

functions.name: IedServer_getStringAttributeValue
functions.signature: const char* IedServer_getStringAttributeValue(IedServer self, const DataAttribute* dataAttribute);
functions.description: Reads a string attribute (MMS_STRING or MMS_VISIBLE_STRING) and returns a C string.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
Behavior is undefined if dataAttribute type differs.
Returned string is managed by server; treat as read-only.

functions.name: IedServer_getFunctionalConstrainedData
functions.signature: MmsValue* IedServer_getFunctionalConstrainedData(IedServer self, DataObject* dataObject, FunctionalConstraint fc);
functions.description: Returns the MmsValue for a functional constrained data (FCD) object specified by DataObject and FC. Direct access bypasses report notifications—use with care.
requirements: self, dataObject must be valid.
Modifying the returned value affects server state and bypasses reporting/GOOSE triggers.

functions.name: IedServer_updateAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, MmsValue* value);
functions.description: Updates a data attribute with the provided MmsValue, performing trigger checks for enabled report/GOOSE control blocks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
value must be a valid MmsValue of the attribute’s type.
Use this (or typed helpers) instead of modifying cached MmsValue directly.

functions.name: IedServer_updateFloatAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateFloatAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, float value);
functions.description: Updates a FLOAT attribute without directly handling MmsValue. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be of type MMS_FLOAT.

functions.name: IedServer_updateInt32AttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateInt32AttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, int32_t value);
functions.description: Updates a 32-bit integer attribute without directly handling MmsValue. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be of integer type compatible with 32-bit.

functions.name: IedServer_updateDbposValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateDbposValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, Dbpos value);
functions.description: Updates a Dbpos (double point) attribute. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be of Dbpos type.

functions.name: IedServer_updateInt64AttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateInt64AttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, int64_t value);
functions.description: Updates a 64-bit integer attribute (e.g., BCR actVal). Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be of integer type compatible with 64-bit.

functions.name: IedServer_updateUnsignedAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateUnsignedAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, uint32_t value);
functions.description: Updates an unsigned integer attribute. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be of MMS_UNSIGNED type.

functions.name: IedServer_updateBitStringAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateBitStringAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, uint32_t value);
functions.description: Updates a bit string attribute using an integer representation. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be MMS_BIT_STRING.

functions.name: IedServer_updateBooleanAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateBooleanAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, bool value);
functions.description: Updates a boolean attribute. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be MMS_BOOLEAN.

functions.name: IedServer_updateVisibleStringAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateVisibleStringAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, char* value);
functions.description: Updates a visible string attribute. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
value must be a null-terminated string.
dataAttribute must be MMS_VISIBLE_STRING (or compatible string type).

functions.name: IedServer_updateUTCTimeAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateUTCTimeAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, uint64_t value);
functions.description: Updates a UTC time attribute using a millisecond-since-epoch timestamp. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be MMS_UTC_TIME.

functions.name: IedServer_updateTimestampAttributeValue
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateTimestampAttributeValue(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, Timestamp* timestamp);
functions.description: Updates a UTC time attribute using a Timestamp object. Triggers report/GOOSE checks.
requirements: self, dataAttribute, timestamp must be valid.
dataAttribute must be MMS_UTC_TIME-compatible.

functions.name: IedServer_updateQuality
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateQuality(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, Quality quality);
functions.description: Updates a Quality (q) attribute using a specialized API that also evaluates the qchg trigger condition for reporting.
requirements: self, dataAttribute must be valid.
dataAttribute must be a Quality (q) attribute.

functions.name: IedServer_changeActiveSettingGroup
functions.signature: void IedServer_changeActiveSettingGroup(IedServer self, SettingGroupControlBlock* sgcb, uint8_t newActiveSg);
functions.description: Informs the server that the active setting group has been changed internally. Update relevant FC=SG attributes before calling.
requirements: self and sgcb must be valid.
newActiveSg is a group number (valid range not specified).

functions.name: IedServer_getActiveSettingGroup
functions.description: Returns the current active setting group number for the given SGCB.
requirements: self and sgcb must be valid.

functions.name: IedServer_setActiveSettingGroupChangedHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setActiveSettingGroupChangedHandler(IedServer self, SettingGroupControlBlock* sgcb, ActiveSettingGroupChangedHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked before the active setting group is changed by a client; return false to reject.
requirements: self and sgcb must be valid.
handler must match ActiveSettingGroupChangedHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setEditSettingGroupChangedHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setEditSettingGroupChangedHandler(IedServer self, SettingGroupControlBlock* sgcb, EditSettingGroupChangedHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked before the edit setting group is changed by a client; return false to reject. User should update SE attributes in this callback.
requirements: self and sgcb must be valid.
handler must match EditSettingGroupChangedHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setEditSettingGroupConfirmationHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setEditSettingGroupConfirmationHandler(IedServer self, SettingGroupControlBlock* sgcb, EditSettingGroupConfirmationHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when the edit setting group has been confirmed by a client.
requirements: self and sgcb must be valid.
handler must match EditSettingGroupConfirmationHandler signature.

functions.name: ControlAction_setError
functions.description: Sets the error code to be reported in the next command termination or application error for this control action.
requirements: self must be a valid ControlAction.
error must be a valid ControlLastApplError value.

functions.name: ControlAction_setAddCause
functions.description: Sets the additional cause to be reported in the next command termination or application error for this control action.
requirements: self must be a valid ControlAction.
addCause must be a valid ControlAddCause.

functions.name: ControlAction_getOrCat
functions.description: Gets the originator category provided by the client for the control action.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getOrIdent
functions.description: Gets the originator identifier bytes provided by the client along with its size.
requirements: self must be valid.
orIdentSize must be a valid pointer to receive the size.
Returned pointer memory is managed by the library; treat as read-only.

functions.name: ControlAction_getCtlNum
functions.description: Gets the ctlNum value sent by the client in the control action.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getSynchroCheck
functions.description: Gets the synchroCheck flag provided by the client.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getInterlockCheck
functions.description: Gets the interlockCheck flag provided by the client.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_isSelect
functions.description: Returns true if the control callback context is for a Select (as opposed to Operate).
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getClientConnection
functions.description: Returns the client connection associated with the control action.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getControlObject
functions.description: Returns the controllable data object that is the subject of this control action.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getControlTime
functions.description: Gets the OperTm time of the control if it’s a time-activated control; returns 0 if not time-activated.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: ControlAction_getT
functions.description: Gets the T attribute (time) of the last received control action (Oper or Select).
requirements: self must be valid.
Returned pointer is managed by library.

functions.name: IedServer_setControlHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setControlHandler(IedServer self, DataObject* node, ControlHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers the main control handler callback for a controllable data object (e.g., SPC/DPC/APC).
requirements: self and node must be valid.
handler must match ControlHandler signature.
Control-related structures must be present in the data model for the object.

functions.name: IedServer_setPerformCheckHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setPerformCheckHandler(IedServer self, DataObject* node, ControlPerformCheckHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a handler to perform static tests (e.g., interlock, access checks) for a control operation. Optional.
requirements: self and node must be valid.
handler must match ControlPerformCheckHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setWaitForExecutionHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setWaitForExecutionHandler(IedServer self, DataObject* node, ControlWaitForExecutionHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a handler to perform dynamic tests (e.g., synchrocheck). Optional. May return WAITING to be re-invoked later.
requirements: self and node must be valid.
handler must match ControlWaitForExecutionHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setSelectStateChangedHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setSelectStateChangedHandler(IedServer self, DataObject* node, ControlSelectStateChangedHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback to track select state changes for a control (selected, canceled, timeout, operated, failed, disconnected).
requirements: self and node must be valid.
handler must match ControlSelectStateChangedHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_updateCtlModel
functions.signature: void IedServer_updateCtlModel(IedServer self, DataObject* ctlObject, ControlModel value);
functions.description: Updates the control model for a controllable data object and writes the ctlModel attribute accordingly.
requirements: self and ctlObject must be valid.
Corresponding control structures must be present in the data model.

functions.name: IedServer_setRCBEventHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setRCBEventHandler(IedServer self, IedServer_RCBEventHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback for report control block events (reservation, enable/disable, GI, set parameter, overflow, etc.).
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match IedServer_RCBEventHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setSVCBHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setSVCBHandler(IedServer self, SVControlBlock* svcb, SVCBEventHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback for SVCB enable/disable events.
requirements: self and svcb must be valid.
handler must match SVCBEventHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setGoCBHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setGoCBHandler(IedServer self, GoCBEventHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Registers a callback for GoCB enable/disable events to integrate an external GOOSE publisher.
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match GoCBEventHandler signature.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getName
functions.description: Returns the GoCB name string.
requirements: self must be valid.
Returned pointer is managed by library; treat as read-only unless docs state otherwise.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getLogicalNode
functions.description: Returns the logical node containing this GoCB.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getDataSet
functions.description: Returns the DataSet bound to this GoCB.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getGoEna
functions.description: Returns whether the GoCB is enabled (GoEna).
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getMinTime
functions.description: Returns the MinTime parameter of the GoCB (milliseconds).
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getMaxTime
functions.description: Returns the MaxTime parameter of the GoCB (milliseconds).
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getFixedOffs
functions.description: Returns the FixedOffs parameter of the GoCB.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: MmsGooseControlBlock_getNdsCom
functions.description: Returns the NdsCom parameter of the GoCB.
requirements: self must be valid.

functions.name: IedServer_handleWriteAccess
functions.signature: void IedServer_handleWriteAccess(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, WriteAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a write-access handler for a specific data attribute to intercept and allow/deny write attempts. Default write policy will not be applied for that attribute.
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
handler must match WriteAccessHandler signature.
Does not apply to sub-attributes—only the specified attribute.

functions.name: IedServer_handleWriteAccessForComplexAttribute
functions.signature: void IedServer_handleWriteAccessForComplexAttribute(IedServer self, DataAttribute* dataAttribute, WriteAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a write-access handler for a complex attribute and all its sub-attributes (or behaves like handleWriteAccess for basic attributes).
requirements: self and dataAttribute must be valid.
handler must match WriteAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_handleWriteAccessForDataObject
functions.signature: void IedServer_handleWriteAccessForDataObject(IedServer self, DataObject* dataObject, FunctionalConstraint fc, WriteAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a write-access handler for all data attributes of a data object for a specific functional constraint (FC).
requirements: self and dataObject must be valid.
fc must be a valid FunctionalConstraint.
handler must match WriteAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setWriteAccessPolicy
functions.signature: void IedServer_setWriteAccessPolicy(IedServer self, FunctionalConstraint fc, AccessPolicy policy);
functions.description: Sets the default write-access policy (allow/deny) for functional constraint data with the given FC.
requirements: self must be valid.
fc must be a valid FunctionalConstraint.
policy must be ACCESS_POLICY_ALLOW or ACCESS_POLICY_DENY.

functions.name: IedServer_setReadAccessHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setReadAccessHandler(IedServer self, ReadAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a global read-access handler called before granting read access to any data object. Can implement RBAC.
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match ReadAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setDataSetAccessHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setDataSetAccessHandler(IedServer self, IedServer_DataSetAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a handler to control client dataset operations (create, delete, read, write, get directory). Called before RCB-related handlers for relevant operations.
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match IedServer_DataSetAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setDirectoryAccessHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setDirectoryAccessHandler(IedServer self, IedServer_DirectoryAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a handler to control access to directory listings (LD list, data list, dataset list, log list).
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match IedServer_DirectoryAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setListObjectsAccessHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setListObjectsAccessHandler(IedServer self, IedServer_ListObjectsAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a handler to control which objects are returned by list-objects services on a per-object basis.
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match IedServer_ListObjectsAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_setControlBlockAccessHandler
functions.signature: void IedServer_setControlBlockAccessHandler(IedServer self, IedServer_ControlBlockAccessHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Installs a handler to control read/write access to control blocks and logs (SGCB, LCBs, URCBs, BRCBs, GoCBs, SVCBs, logs).
requirements: self must be valid.
handler must match IedServer_ControlBlockAccessHandler signature.

functions.name: IedServer_ignoreReadAccess
functions.description: Temporarily ignores read requests for testing.
requirements: self must be valid.
When ignore=true, clients’ read requests will be ignored.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_destroy
functions.description: Deletes an MmsVariableSpecification instance and all of its recursively contained children. After this call, the instance and any pointers obtained from it must not be used.
requirements: self must point to a valid MmsVariableSpecification instance allocated/owned by this API.
After calling this function, the object is invalid; do not access self or any child specifications or strings previously returned from it.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getChildValue
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsValue* MmsVariableSpecification_getChildValue(MmsVariableSpecification* self, MmsValue* value, const char* childId);
functions.description: Returns the child MmsValue of value corresponding to the child identified by childId within the variable specification self. The childId must be provided in MMS mapping syntax using '$' as the path separator.
requirements: self must be the MmsVariableSpecification that describes the structure of value.
value must be an MmsValue corresponding to self (same shape/type).
childId must be a relative MMS name string using '$' as separators between path elements (e.g., "A$B$C").
Behavior for non-existent paths or mismatched types is not documented; callers should expect a possible NULL return or implementation-defined behavior.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getNamedVariableRecursive
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsVariableSpecification* MmsVariableSpecification_getNamedVariableRecursive(MmsVariableSpecification* self, const char* nameId);
functions.description: Returns the child variable specification of self addressed by the relative MMS name nameId, traversing recursively. Uses '$' as the separator between path elements. Returns NULL if the child does not exist.
requirements: nameId must be a relative MMS name string using '$' as separators.
self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
Caller must handle a NULL return when the path does not exist.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getType
functions.description: Returns the MMS type of the variable described by self.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_isValueOfType
functions.signature: LIB61850_API bool MmsVariableSpecification_isValueOfType(MmsVariableSpecification* self, const MmsValue* value);
functions.description: Checks whether value has exactly the same type as specified by self. Returns true if the types match, false otherwise.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
value must be a valid MmsValue pointer (may be NULL only if implementation allows; not documented).
Caller must check the boolean return to determine compatibility.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getName
functions.description: Returns the (null-terminated) name of the variable described by self. The returned pointer remains valid only as long as the MmsVariableSpecification instance exists.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
Do not free the returned string; it is owned by the MmsVariableSpecification.
Do not use the returned pointer after the MmsVariableSpecification has been destroyed.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getStructureElements
functions.description: For a variable of type MMS_STRUCTURE, returns a LinkedList of null-terminated char* element names. The caller owns the returned list and its elements and should release them with LinkedList_destroy. Returns NULL if self is not of type MMS_STRUCTURE.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
Caller becomes the owner of the returned LinkedList and its char* elements and must free them using LinkedList_destroy.
Caller must handle a NULL return when self is not of type MMS_STRUCTURE.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getSize
functions.description: Returns the number of elements for complex types (structure, array) or the bit size for integer, unsigned integer, float, bit-string, visible/MMS string, and octet-string types. Returns -1 if not applicable.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
Caller must handle a return value of -1 when size is not applicable.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getChildSpecificationByIndex
functions.description: Returns the child MmsVariableSpecification of self at the given index. Typically used for structures or arrays. Details on out-of-range handling are not documented.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification representing a composite type (structure or array).
index should refer to an existing child (0-based indexing is implied by common C conventions, but exact base is not explicitly documented).
Behavior for out-of-range index is not documented; callers should expect a possible NULL return.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getChildSpecificationByName
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsVariableSpecification* MmsVariableSpecification_getChildSpecificationByName(MmsVariableSpecification* self, const char* name, int* index);
functions.description: Returns the child (e.g., structure element) specification of self with the given component name. If index is non-NULL, the function stores the component's index there. Returns NULL if the component is not found.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification (typically a structure).
name must be a valid null-terminated component name.
If index is not NULL, it must point to writable memory to receive the element index.
Caller must handle a NULL return when the component is not found.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getArrayElementSpecification
functions.description: For an array-type specification, returns the MmsVariableSpecification describing the array element type. Behavior for non-array types is not documented.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
Intended to be called when self represents an array (MMS array).
Behavior/return value when self is not an array is not documented; callers should handle a possible NULL return.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getExponentWidth
functions.description: Returns the exponent width for floating-point types. The header does not document precise semantics or behavior for non-floating types.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsVariableSpecification.
Intended for use when self is a floating-point type; behavior for other types is not documented and may return an unspecified value (callers should be prepared for implementation-defined results).

functions.name: MmsValue_createArray
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_createArray(const MmsVariableSpecification* elementType, int size);
functions.description: Creates a new MMS array value with the given element type and initializes each element to its default value.
requirements: elementType must describe the type of each array element (non-NULL).
size must be >= 0; negative sizes are invalid.
Returned MmsValue* must be deleted with MmsValue_delete when no longer needed.

functions.name: MmsValue_getArraySize
functions.description: Returns the number of elements contained in an MMS array value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_ARRAY.

functions.name: MmsValue_getElement
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_getElement(const MmsValue* array, int index);
functions.description: Returns the element at index for an MMS array or structure.
requirements: array must be non-NULL and of type MMS_ARRAY or MMS_STRUCTURE.
index must be within [0, element_count-1]; out-of-range likely returns NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_createEmptyArray
functions.description: Creates a new empty MMS array with the given size (elements initially unset/uninitialized).
requirements: size must be >= 0.
Caller must later fill elements via MmsValue_setElement.
Returned MmsValue* must be deleted with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_setElement
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setElement(MmsValue* complexValue, int index, MmsValue* elementValue);
functions.description: Sets or replaces the element at index in an MMS array or structure.
requirements: complexValue must be non-NULL and of type MMS_STRUCTURE or MMS_ARRAY.
index must be within [0, element_count-1].
elementValue must be a valid MmsValue* of the correct element type.
If an element already exists it is replaced; the caller is responsible to free the replaced value.

functions.name: MmsValue_getDataAccessError
functions.description: Returns the MMS data access error code embedded in the value (if of that error type).
requirements: self must be non-NULL; meaningful when self is an error-valued MmsValue (MmsDataAccessError).

functions.name: MmsValue_toInt64
functions.description: Converts an MMS integer/unsigned value to a signed 64-bit integer.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER or MMS_UNSIGNED.
Value must fit in int64_t; overflow behavior is library-defined (not documented).

functions.name: MmsValue_toInt32
functions.description: Converts an MMS integer/unsigned value to a signed 32-bit integer.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER or MMS_UNSIGNED.
Value must fit in int32_t; overflow behavior is library-defined (not documented).

functions.name: MmsValue_toUint32
functions.description: Converts an MMS integer/unsigned value to an unsigned 32-bit integer.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER or MMS_UNSIGNED.
Value must fit in uint32_t; overflow behavior is library-defined (not documented).

functions.name: MmsValue_toDouble
functions.description: Returns the 64-bit floating-point value from an MMS float value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_FLOAT.

functions.name: MmsValue_toFloat
functions.description: Returns the 32-bit floating-point value from an MMS float value.
