requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_FLOAT.

functions.name: MmsValue_toUnixTimestamp
functions.description: Returns the seconds-since-epoch from an MMS UTC time value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTC_TIME (MMS_UTCTIME).

functions.name: MmsValue_setFloat
functions.description: Sets the 32-bit float value of an MMS float value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_FLOAT.

functions.name: MmsValue_setDouble
functions.description: Sets the 64-bit double value of an MMS float value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_FLOAT.

functions.name: MmsValue_setInt8
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS integer to an 8-bit signed value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER.

functions.name: MmsValue_setInt16
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS integer to a 16-bit signed value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER.

functions.name: MmsValue_setInt32
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS integer to a 32-bit signed value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER.

functions.name: MmsValue_setInt64
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS integer to a 64-bit signed value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_INTEGER.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUint8
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS unsigned integer to an 8-bit unsigned value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UNSIGNED.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUint16
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS unsigned integer to a 16-bit unsigned value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UNSIGNED.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUint32
functions.description: Sets the value of an MMS unsigned integer to a 32-bit unsigned value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UNSIGNED.

functions.name: MmsValue_setBoolean
functions.description: Sets the boolean value of an MMS boolean.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BOOLEAN.

functions.name: MmsValue_getBoolean
functions.description: Returns the boolean value of an MMS boolean.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BOOLEAN.

functions.name: MmsValue_toString
functions.description: Returns the C-string (null-terminated) of an MMS visible string or MMS string value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_VISIBLE_STRING or MMS_STRING.
The returned pointer refers to internal storage; do not free or modify.
String lifetime is tied to the MmsValue instance.

functions.name: MmsValue_getStringSize
functions.description: Returns the (maximum) string length (allocated size minus one) for MMS string/visible string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_VISIBLE_STRING or MMS_STRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_setVisibleString
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setVisibleString(MmsValue* self, const char* string);
functions.description: Sets the content of an MMS visible string value from a C-string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_VISIBLE_STRING.
string must be a valid null-terminated string whose length fits the allocated buffer; excess may be truncated or rejected (not specified).

functions.name: MmsValue_setBitStringBit
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setBitStringBit(MmsValue* self, int bitPos, bool value);
functions.description: Sets or clears a single bit in an MMS bit string at the given bit position (LSB is position 0 in serialization order).
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.
bitPos must be within [0, bitstring_size_bits-1].

functions.name: MmsValue_getBitStringBit
functions.signature: bool MmsValue_getBitStringBit(const MmsValue* self, int bitPos);
functions.description: Returns the value of a single bit in an MMS bit string at the given bit position (LSB is position 0 in serialization order).
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.
bitPos must be within [0, bitstring_size_bits-1].

functions.name: MmsValue_deleteAllBitStringBits
functions.description: Clears all bits (sets to zero) in an MMS bit string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_getBitStringSize
functions.description: Returns the size of an MMS bit string in bits.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_getBitStringByteSize
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required by the MMS bit string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_getNumberOfSetBits
functions.description: Counts and returns the number of set (1) bits in an MMS bit string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_setAllBitStringBits
functions.description: Sets all bits (to one) in an MMS bit string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_getBitStringAsInteger
functions.description: Interprets the bit string as a little-endian bit-order unsigned integer and returns it.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.
Bit string length must be <= 32 bits for the conversion to fit in uint32_t.

functions.name: MmsValue_setBitStringFromInteger
functions.description: Sets the bit string bits from an unsigned integer assuming little-endian bit order (bit 0 is LSB).
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.
Only the least significant N bits (N = bitstring size) are applied; higher bits are ignored.

functions.name: MmsValue_getBitStringAsIntegerBigEndian
functions.description: Interprets the bit string as a big-endian bit-order unsigned integer and returns it.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.
Bit string length must be <= 32 bits for the conversion to fit in uint32_t.

functions.name: MmsValue_setBitStringFromIntegerBigEndian
functions.description: Sets the bit string bits from an unsigned integer assuming big-endian bit order (bit 0 is MSB).
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BITSTRING.
Only the most significant N bits (per big-endian mapping) corresponding to the bitstring size are applied.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUtcTime
functions.description: Sets an MMS UTC time value using seconds since Unix epoch and returns the updated value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME (note: comment has a typo mentioning MMS_BOOLEAN).
timeval is seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUtcTimeMs
functions.description: Sets an MMS UTC time value using milliseconds since Unix epoch and returns the updated value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.
timeval is milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUtcTimeByBuffer
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setUtcTimeByBuffer(MmsValue* self, const uint8_t* buffer);
functions.description: Sets an MMS UTC time value from an 8-byte BER-encoded UTCTime buffer.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.
buffer must be non-NULL and exactly 8 bytes long.

functions.name: MmsValue_getUtcTimeBuffer
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal 8-byte raw buffer of an MMS UTC time value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.
Returned pointer is to internal storage; do not free; size is 8 bytes.

functions.name: MmsValue_getUtcTimeInMs
functions.description: Returns the milliseconds since Unix epoch contained in an MMS UTC time value.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.

functions.name: MmsValue_getUtcTimeInMsWithUs
functions.signature: uint64_t MmsValue_getUtcTimeInMsWithUs(const MmsValue* self, uint32_t* usec);
functions.description: Returns the milliseconds since Unix epoch from an MMS UTC time value and optionally stores the microsecond part in usec.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.
usec may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must be a valid pointer to receive microseconds (0..999,999 per typical semantics; exact range not specified).

functions.name: MmsValue_setUtcTimeQuality
functions.description: Sets the time quality byte of an MMS UTC time value (leapSecondsKnown, clockFailure, clockNotSynchronized, subsecond accuracy bits).
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.

functions.name: MmsValue_setUtcTimeMsEx
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_setUtcTimeMsEx(MmsValue* self, uint64_t timeval, uint8_t timeQuality);
functions.description: Sets an MMS UTC time value using milliseconds since epoch and an explicit time quality byte; returns the updated value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.
timeval is milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

functions.name: MmsValue_getUtcTimeQuality
functions.description: Gets the time quality byte from an MMS UTC time value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_UTCTIME.

functions.name: MmsValue_setBinaryTime
functions.description: Sets an MMS binary time value (milliseconds since epoch).
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BINARYTIME.
timestamp is milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

functions.name: MmsValue_getBinaryTimeAsUtcMs
functions.description: Gets milliseconds since epoch from an MMS binary time value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_BINARYTIME.

functions.name: MmsValue_setOctetString
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setOctetString(MmsValue* self, const uint8_t* buf, int size);
functions.description: Sets the content of an MMS octet string by copying from a buffer if it fits the internal buffer size.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_OCTET_STRING.
buf must be non-NULL if size > 0.
size must be >= 0 and must not exceed the internal maximum size; otherwise, the value is not changed.

functions.name: MmsValue_setOctetStringOctet
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setOctetStringOctet(MmsValue* self, int octetPos, uint8_t value);
functions.description: Sets a single octet at position octetPos in an MMS octet string if within the internal buffer size.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_OCTET_STRING.
octetPos must be within [0, max_size-1]; otherwise, the value is not changed.

functions.name: MmsValue_getOctetStringSize
functions.description: Returns the current size in bytes of an MMS octet string value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_OCTET_STRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_getOctetStringMaxSize
functions.description: Returns the maximum capacity (allocated buffer size) for an MMS octet string value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_OCTET_STRING.

functions.name: MmsValue_getOctetStringBuffer
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer of an MMS octet string value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_OCTET_STRING.
Use MmsValue_getOctetStringSize to determine current valid byte count; do not free the returned pointer.

functions.name: MmsValue_getOctetStringOctet
functions.description: Returns the value of a single octet at position octetPos from an MMS octet string.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and of type MMS_OCTET_STRING.
octetPos must be within [0, size-1].

functions.name: MmsValue_update
functions.signature: bool MmsValue_update(MmsValue* self, const MmsValue* source);
functions.description: Updates this value’s content from another value of the same type; returns success.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.
source must be non-NULL and of the same type as self; otherwise the call has no effect (returns false).

functions.name: MmsValue_equals
functions.signature: bool MmsValue_equals(const MmsValue* self, const MmsValue* otherValue);
functions.description: Compares two MMS values for value equality and type compatibility.
requirements: self and otherValue must be non-NULL.
Values should be of the same type; otherwise returns false.

functions.name: MmsValue_equalTypes
functions.signature: bool MmsValue_equalTypes(const MmsValue* self, const MmsValue* otherValue);
functions.description: Checks if two (possibly complex) MMS values have identical types recursively for all children.
requirements: self and otherValue must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_newDataAccessError
functions.description: Creates an MMS value that represents a data access error with the given error code.
requirements: No special preconditions; accessError should be a valid MmsDataAccessError enum value.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newInteger
functions.description: Allocates a new MMS integer with the given bit-width (size).
requirements: size should be a positive bit-width appropriate for the library expectations (exact units unspecified; inferred as bits).
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newUnsigned
functions.description: Allocates a new MMS unsigned integer with the given bit-width (size).
requirements: size should be a positive bit-width appropriate for the library expectations (exact units unspecified; inferred as bits).
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newBoolean
functions.description: Creates a new MMS boolean value initialized to the given bool.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newBitString
functions.description: Creates a new MMS bit string with the specified size in bits.
requirements: bitSize must be >= 0.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newOctetString
functions.description: Creates a new MMS octet string with initial size and maximum capacity.
requirements: size must be >= 0 and <= maxSize.
maxSize must be >= 0.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newStructure
functions.description: Creates a new MMS structure value based on the provided type specification.
requirements: typeSpec must be non-NULL and define a MMS_STRUCTURE.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_createEmptyStructure
functions.description: Creates a new empty MMS structure with the specified number of elements.
requirements: size must be >= 0.
Elements must be assigned later with MmsValue_setElement.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newDefaultValue
functions.description: Creates a new MMS value initialized with the default for the given type specification (recursively for complex types).
requirements: typeSpec must be non-NULL.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newIntegerFromInt8
functions.description: Creates a new MMS integer initialized from an 8-bit signed value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newIntegerFromInt16
functions.description: Creates a new MMS integer initialized from a 16-bit signed value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newIntegerFromInt32
functions.description: Creates a new MMS integer initialized from a 32-bit signed value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newIntegerFromInt64
functions.description: Creates a new MMS integer initialized from a 64-bit signed value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newUnsignedFromUint32
functions.description: Creates a new MMS unsigned integer initialized from a 32-bit unsigned value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newFloat
functions.description: Creates a new MMS float (32-bit) value initialized to value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newDouble
functions.description: Creates a new MMS float (64-bit) value initialized to value.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_clone
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of an MMS value, allocating new memory for the clone.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.
Caller must free the returned clone with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_cloneToBuffer
functions.signature: uint8_t* MmsValue_cloneToBuffer(const MmsValue* self, uint8_t* destinationAddress);
functions.description: Performs a deep copy of an MMS value into a caller-provided buffer; returns pointer just past the last written byte.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.
destinationAddress must be non-NULL and point to a buffer large enough to hold the clone.
Use MmsValue_getSizeInMemory to compute required buffer size beforehand.

functions.name: MmsValue_getSizeInMemory
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to clone this MMS value into a flat buffer.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_delete
functions.description: Deletes an MMS value and all dynamically allocated children (for arrays/structures).
requirements: self may be NULL (no effect).
Do not call if ownership is not with caller per library protocol.

functions.name: MmsValue_deleteConditional
functions.description: Conditionally deletes an MMS value and its children only if its internal deletable flag permits (deleteValue field = 0).
requirements: value may be NULL (no effect).
Deletion occurs only if deleteValue field = 0; otherwise the instance is kept.

functions.name: MmsValue_newVisibleString
functions.description: Creates a new MMS visible string with content copied from the provided C-string (or empty if NULL).
requirements: string may be NULL to create an empty string.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newVisibleStringWithSize
functions.description: Creates a new empty MMS visible string with maximum size equal to size.
requirements: size must be >= 0; memory allocated to hold up to size characters.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newMmsStringWithSize
functions.description: Creates a new empty MMS string (ISO 9506 MMS_STRING) with maximum size equal to size.
requirements: size must be >= 0.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newBinaryTime
functions.description: Creates a new MMS binary time value; if timeOfDay is true it is 4 octets (seconds since midnight), otherwise full binary time.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newVisibleStringFromByteArray
functions.description: Creates a new MMS visible string from a raw byte array of given size.
requirements: byteArray must be non-NULL if size > 0; size must be >= 0.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newMmsStringFromByteArray
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_newMmsStringFromByteArray(const uint8_t* byteArray, int size);
functions.description: Creates a new MMS string from a raw byte array of given size.
requirements: byteArray must be non-NULL if size > 0; size must be >= 0.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_newMmsString
functions.description: Creates a new MMS string initialized from a C-string (or empty if NULL).
requirements: string may be NULL to create an empty string.
Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_setMmsString
functions.signature: void MmsValue_setMmsString(MmsValue* value, const char* string);
functions.description: Sets the content of an MMS string value from a C-string.
requirements: value must be non-NULL and of type MMS_STRING.
string must be a valid null-terminated string that fits into the allocated max size.

functions.name: MmsValue_newUtcTime
functions.description: Creates a new MMS UTC time initialized with seconds since epoch.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.
timeval is seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

functions.name: MmsValue_newUtcTimeByMsTime
functions.description: Creates a new MMS UTC time initialized with milliseconds since epoch.
requirements: Returned value must be freed with MmsValue_delete.
timeval is milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

functions.name: MmsValue_setDeletable
functions.description: Marks an MMS value as deletable by libiec61850 API clients (sets deletable flag).
requirements: self must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_setDeletableRecursive
functions.description: Marks an MMS value and all its children as deletable (recursively).
requirements: value must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_isDeletable
functions.description: Returns 1 if the deletable flag is set on the value (0 otherwise).
requirements: self must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_getType
functions.description: Returns the MMS type (MmsType enum) of the value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsValue_getSubElement
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_getSubElement(MmsValue* self, MmsVariableSpecification* varSpec, char* mmsPath);
functions.description: Retrieves a sub-element from an MMS structure value by MMS path using the provided type specification.
requirements: self must be non-NULL; must refer to an MMS_STRUCTURE value.
varSpec must be non-NULL and describe the structure type.
mmsPath must be a valid MMS variable path string.
Returns NULL if the element does not exist.

functions.name: MmsValue_getTypeString
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the value’s MMS type.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer refers to a static or internal string; do not free.

functions.name: MmsValue_printToBuffer
functions.signature: const char* MmsValue_printToBuffer(const MmsValue* self, char* buffer, int bufferSize);
functions.description: Writes a human-readable representation of the MMS value into buffer and returns buffer.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.
buffer must be non-NULL and bufferSize > 0.
Requires a full-featured snprintf on the platform (debugging aid).

functions.name: MmsValue_decodeMmsData
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_decodeMmsData(uint8_t* buffer, int bufPos, int bufferLength, int* endBufPos);
functions.description: Deserializes a BER-encoded MMS Data element from buffer into a new MmsValue (returns created value).
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and bufferLength >= 0.
bufPos must be within [0, bufferLength).
endBufPos may be NULL; if non-NULL, it receives the end position just after the decoded element.
Caller must free the returned value with MmsValue_delete.
API changed with version 1.0.3 to add endBufPos parameter.

functions.name: MmsValue_decodeMmsDataMaxRecursion
functions.signature: MmsValue* MmsValue_decodeMmsDataMaxRecursion(uint8_t* buffer, int bufPos, int bufferLength, int* endBufPos, int maxDepth);
functions.description: Deserializes a BER-encoded MMS Data element with a maximum recursion depth limit.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and bufferLength >= 0.
bufPos must be within [0, bufferLength).
maxDepth must be >= 0; deeper nesting beyond maxDepth will cause failure.
endBufPos may be NULL; if non-NULL, receives end position.
Caller must free the returned value with MmsValue_delete.

functions.name: MmsValue_encodeMmsData
functions.signature: int MmsValue_encodeMmsData(MmsValue* self, uint8_t* buffer, int bufPos, bool encode);
functions.description: Serializes the value as a BER-encoded MMS Data element into buffer or, if encode=false, returns the encoded length only.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.
If encode is true: buffer must be non-NULL and large enough; bufPos must be >= 0.
If encode is false: buffer may be NULL; bufPos is used for size computation starting offset.

functions.name: MmsValue_getMaxEncodedSize
functions.description: Returns the maximum possible BER-encoded size in bytes of this MMS value.
requirements: self must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsVariableSpecification_getMaxEncodedSize
functions.description: Returns the maximum encoded size of a variable described by this type specification.
requirements: self must be non-NULL and describe a valid MMS variable type.

functions.name: MmsError_toString
functions.description: Returns a static C-string name/description for the given MmsError code.
requirements: Returned pointer must not be freed by the caller.

functions.name: MmsConnection_create
functions.description: Create a new MMS client connection instance in threaded/default mode.
requirements: Must be destroyed with MmsConnection_destroy when no longer needed.
Returned handle must be passed to other MmsConnection_* APIs.
No parameters.

functions.name: MmsConnection_createSecure
functions.description: Create a new TLS-enabled MMS client connection instance using the provided TLS configuration.
requirements: tlsConfig must be a valid TLSConfiguration initialized according to tls_config.h.
Must be destroyed with MmsConnection_destroy.
Use only if MMS-over-TLS is desired.

functions.name: MmsConnection_createNonThreaded
functions.description: Create a new MMS client connection instance configured for non-threaded mode. Caller must periodically drive the connection state machine with MmsConnection_tick.
requirements: If tlsConfig is non-NULL it must be a valid TLSConfiguration; pass NULL for non-TLS.
In non-threaded mode, MmsConnection_tick must be called periodically to handle connection.
Destroy with MmsConnection_destroy.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setRawMessageHandler
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_setRawMessageHandler(MmsConnection self, MmsRawMessageHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Install a callback to intercept raw MMS messages for logging/debugging when CONFIG_MMS_RAW_MESSAGE_LOGGING is enabled.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
handler may be NULL to disable interception.
The provided message buffer in the callback is only valid during the callback; copy if needed.
Feature works only if CONFIG_MMS_RAW_MESSAGE_LOGGING is enabled in stack_config.h.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setFilestoreBasepath
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_setFilestoreBasepath(MmsConnection self, const char* basepath);
functions.description: Set the virtual filestore base directory used by MMS obtain file services for this connection.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
basepath must be a valid C string path.
Available only if CONFIG_SET_FILESTORE_BASEPATH_AT_RUNTIME is enabled in stack_config.h.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setRequestTimeout
functions.description: Set the per-request timeout (milliseconds) for this connection.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
timeoutInMs must be a non-negative timeout in milliseconds.

functions.name: MmsConnnection_setMaxOutstandingCalls
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnnection_setMaxOutstandingCalls(MmsConnection self, int calling, int called);
functions.description: Set the maximum number of outstanding MMS service calls allowed (client and server side limits).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
calling and called should be non-negative integers representing allowed outstanding calls.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getRequestTimeout
functions.description: Get the current per-request timeout (milliseconds) configured for this connection.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setConnectTimeout
functions.description: Set the connection establishment timeout (milliseconds) for this connection instance.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
timeoutInMs must be a non-negative timeout in milliseconds.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setInformationReportHandler
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_setInformationReportHandler(MmsConnection self, MmsInformationReportHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Install a handler for unsolicited MMS information report messages received from the server.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
handler may be NULL to disable reports.
Caller is responsible to properly free the MmsValue passed to the handler.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getIsoConnectionParameters
functions.description: Retrieve the ISO OSI-Stack connection parameters used by this connection.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getMmsConnectionParameters
functions.description: Retrieve MMS-layer specific connection parameters (e.g., PDU size, nesting level, services supported) for this connection.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setConnectionStateChangedHandler
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_setConnectionStateChangedHandler(MmsConnection self, MmsConnectionStateChangedHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Install a callback invoked when the MMS connection state changes (closed, connecting, connected, closing).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
handler may be NULL to remove the callback.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setConnectionLostHandler
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_setConnectionLostHandler(MmsConnection self, MmsConnectionLostHandler handler, void* handlerParameter);
functions.description: Install a callback invoked when the connection to the MMS server is lost.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
handler may be NULL to disable notifications.

functions.name: MmsConnection_setIsoConnectionParameters
functions.description: Set ISO connection parameters to be used by this MmsConnection instance.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
params must point to a valid IsoConnectionParameters structure.

functions.name: MmsConnection_destroy
functions.description: Destroy an MmsConnection instance and release all associated resources.
requirements: self must be a MmsConnection created by one of the create functions or NULL.
After destruction, self must not be used.

functions.name: MmsConnection_connect
functions.signature: LIB61850_API bool MmsConnection_connect(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* serverName, int serverPort);
functions.description: Open a TCP connection and send an MMS initiate request to the specified server (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer to store an error code.
serverName must be a valid hostname or IP string.
serverPort may be -1 to use default (102 for MMS, 3872 for MMS over TLS) or a valid TCP port.
Returns true on success, false on failure.

functions.name: MmsConnection_connectAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_connectAsync(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* serverName, int serverPort);
functions.description: Initiate connection establishment asynchronously.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer to store an immediate error code (e.g., dispatch/queueing).
serverName must be a valid hostname or IP.
serverPort may be -1 for default port or a valid TCP port.
Completion notification is via state change/other callbacks; no handler parameter here.

functions.name: MmsConnection_tick
functions.description: Drive the connection state machine and handle I/O for non-threaded mode; call periodically.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection created in non-threaded mode.
Should be called periodically by the application.
Returns true if connection is waiting (caller can sleep), false if busy (call again ASAP).

functions.name: MmsConnection_sendRawData
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_sendRawData(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, uint8_t* buffer, int bufSize);
functions.description: Send raw data over the MMS connection (for test purposes).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
buffer must point to at least bufSize bytes; bufSize must be >= 0.
For testing only.

functions.name: MmsConnection_close
functions.description: Close the TCP socket abruptly without MMS/ACSE handshake (not recommended).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
Behavior is not specified; use with care.

functions.name: MmsConnection_abort
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_abort(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError);
functions.description: Use the MMS/ACSE abort service to close the connection abruptly (blocking). If the server does not close within internal timeout, TCP is closed and mmsError is set to MMS_ERROR_SERVICE_TIMEOUT.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: MmsConnection_abortAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_abortAsync(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError);
functions.description: Asynchronously request an MMS/ACSE abort to close the connection.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer to store immediate errors.

functions.name: MmsConnection_conclude
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_conclude(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError);
functions.description: Use the MMS conclude service to orderly release the connection (blocking). If server denies conclude, mmsError is set and the connection remains open.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
If this fails, caller should use close or abort to terminate the connection.

functions.name: MmsConnection_concludeAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_concludeAsync(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, MmsConnection_ConcludeAbortHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously request MMS conclude to orderly close the connection; completion reported via handler.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
handler may be NULL to suppress callback; parameter is user context.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getVMDVariableNames
functions.description: Get names of all VMD-scope variables on the server (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
Returns a LinkedList of char* or NULL on failure; caller must free list appropriately.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getVMDVariableNamesAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_getVMDVariableNamesAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* continueAfter, MmsConnection_GetNameListHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously get VMD-scope variable names, supporting continuation via continueAfter; results delivered by handler.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId must be a valid pointer to receive invoke ID.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
continueAfter may be NULL for the first call.
handler must be non-NULL to receive results.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainNames
functions.description: Get names of all MMS domains on the server (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
Returns LinkedList of char* or NULL on failure; caller must free list appropriately.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainNamesAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_getDomainNamesAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* continueAfter, LinkedList result, MmsConnection_GetNameListHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously get domain names, optionally appending into provided result list; supports continuation.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
continueAfter may be NULL for first segment.
result may be NULL to create a new list; otherwise must be a LinkedList to append.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainVariableNames
functions.signature: LIB61850_API LinkedList MmsConnection_getDomainVariableNames(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId);
functions.description: Get names of all variables present in the specified MMS domain (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
domainId must be a valid domain name string.
Returns LinkedList of char* or NULL on failure; caller must free list appropriately.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainVariableNamesAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_getDomainVariableNamesAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* continueAfter, LinkedList result, MmsConnection_GetNameListHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously get variable names of a domain; supports continuation and optional append to an existing list.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
domainId must be a valid domain name string.
continueAfter may be NULL for first call.
result may be NULL or a LinkedList to append.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainVariableListNames
functions.signature: LIB61850_API LinkedList MmsConnection_getDomainVariableListNames(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId);
functions.description: Get names of all named variable lists in the given domain, or VMD scope if domainId is NULL (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
domainId may be NULL for VMD scope.
Returns LinkedList of char* or NULL on failure; caller must free list.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainVariableListNamesAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_getDomainVariableListNamesAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* continueAfter, LinkedList result, MmsConnection_GetNameListHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously get named variable list names for a domain or VMD scope; supports continuation and optional result list.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
domainId may be NULL for VMD scope.
continueAfter may be NULL for first call.
result may be NULL or a LinkedList to append.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainJournals
functions.signature: LIB61850_API LinkedList MmsConnection_getDomainJournals(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId);
functions.description: Get names of all journals present in the specified MMS domain (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
domainId must be a valid domain name string.
Returns LinkedList of char* or NULL on failure; caller must free list.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getDomainJournalsAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_getDomainJournalsAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* continueAfter, MmsConnection_GetNameListHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously get journal names for a domain, with continuation support.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
domainId must be a valid domain name.
continueAfter may be NULL for first call.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getVariableListNamesAssociationSpecific
functions.description: Get names of association-specific named variable lists for this client connection (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
Returns LinkedList of char* or NULL on failure; caller must free list.

functions.name: MmsConnection_getVariableListNamesAssociationSpecificAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_getVariableListNamesAssociationSpecificAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* continueAfter, MmsConnection_GetNameListHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously get association-specific named variable list names with continuation support.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
continueAfter may be NULL for first call.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readVariable
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsValue* MmsConnection_readVariable(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId);
functions.description: Read a single MMS variable value (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
domainId may be NULL for VMD-specific variable.
itemId must be a valid variable name.
Returns MmsValue* or NULL; caller must free the MmsValue when no longer needed.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readVariableAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_readVariableAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, MmsConnection_ReadVariableHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously read a single MMS variable value; result delivered via handler.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
domainId may be NULL for VMD-specific variable.
itemId must be valid.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readVariableComponent
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsValue* MmsConnection_readVariableComponent(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, const char* componentId);
functions.description: Read a component of a variable (blocking), using component alternate access.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
domainId may be NULL for VMD-specific variable.
itemId and componentId must be valid names.
Caller must free returned MmsValue if non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readVariableComponentAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_readVariableComponentAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, const char* componentId, MmsConnection_ReadVariableHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously read a variable component; result delivered via handler.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
domainId may be NULL for VMD-specific variable.
itemId and componentId must be valid.
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readArrayElements
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsValue* MmsConnection_readArrayElements(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, uint32_t startIndex, uint32_t numberOfElements);
functions.description: Read one element or a range of elements from an array variable (blocking). Returns either a single value (numberOfElements == 0) or an array of selected elements.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
domainId must be valid; itemId must refer to an array.
startIndex is the element index or start of range; numberOfElements=0 for single element, >0 for range.
Caller must free returned MmsValue if non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readArrayElementsAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_readArrayElementsAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, uint32_t startIndex, uint32_t numberOfElements, MmsConnection_ReadVariableHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously read one element or a range from an array variable; result delivered via handler as single value or array as described.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
domainId and itemId must refer to an array.
startIndex and numberOfElements as specified (0 => single element).
handler must be non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readSingleArrayElementWithComponent
functions.signature: LIB61850_API MmsValue* MmsConnection_readSingleArrayElementWithComponent(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, uint32_t index, const char* componentId);
functions.description: Read a single array element, optionally addressing a named component of that element (blocking).
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
mmsError must be a valid pointer.
itemId must refer to an array; index is the element index; componentId may be NULL or a valid component name.
Caller must free returned MmsValue if non-NULL.

functions.name: MmsConnection_readSingleArrayElementWithComponentAsync
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_readSingleArrayElementWithComponentAsync(MmsConnection self, uint32_t* usedInvokeId, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, const char* itemId, uint32_t index, const char* componentId, MmsConnection_ReadVariableHandler handler, void* parameter);
functions.description: Asynchronously read a single array element (optionally a component) and deliver via handler.
requirements: self must be a valid MmsConnection.
usedInvokeId and mmsError must be valid pointers.
itemId must refer to an array; index is the element index; componentId may be NULL or a component name.

itemId must refer to an array; index/numberOfElements as specified.

functions.name: MmsConnection_writeMultipleVariables
functions.signature: LIB61850_API void MmsConnection_writeMultipleVariables(MmsConnection self, MmsError* mmsError, const char* domainId, LinkedList items, LinkedList values, LinkedList* accessResults);

domainId, items (LinkedList<char*>) and values (LinkedList<MmsValue*>) must be provided with matching order/length.

values must be a LinkedList of MmsValue*.
handler must be non-NULL.
